description: List and search the business's calls, newest first, each with who called (when known) and a short summary of what they wanted. Search by caller phone, by words in the call summary ("water heater", "quote"), and by date window; filters combine. Use get_transcript for the full call.

after.description: Only items at or after this ISO-8601 date or time (optional).

before.description: Only items before this ISO-8601 date or time (optional).

phone.description: Only this caller: any phone format; matches on the last 10 digits (optional).

query.description: Words to find in the call summary, e.g. "water heater" (optional).

name: list_recent_calls
title: List Recent Calls
